title: Metrovpn v2.7.3 Update Available
message: Removes floating in-app toast notifications in favor of a single native Windows notification on connect, replaces 'Add & Connect' with manual 'Add', fixes Servers tab dropdown overlapping & clearly highlights the connected server, adds full support & exact labels (TCP+TLS, TCP+TLS+VCN, WS+TLS, gRPC, XHTTP, HTTPUpgrade, Reality, Trojan, VMess), and auto-updates data quota across every VLESS node.
